paragraphs: R' Yose bar Asi. See the entry R' Yose bar Yasian.[^1]

notes.text: Asi (אסי) and Yasian (יסיאן) remain distinct supplied patronymics with conventional English vowels. Both abbreviated titles remain R'; the notice supplies only a pointer.
